android.desc:
Transform your strength training with the ultimate Wendler 5/3/1 powerlifting tracker and workout calculator — a dedicated 5/3/1 workout app for serious lifters.

AUTOMATIC WEIGHT CALCULATIONS
Enter your one rep max once and never calculate percentages again. Wendler Log instantly generates your complete strength program and training cycle with precise weights for every set. Focus on lifting heavy, not doing math.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Complete lift history with sortable workout logs by date, exercise, reps, and calculated 1RM
• AMRAP (As Many Reps As Possible) score tracking to monitor strength gains and personal records (PRs)
• Progressive overload tracking as weights automatically increase each cycle
• Workout timer and rest periods to optimize training efficiency

FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE PROGRAM
Built around the four main compound lifts - Squat, Bench Press, Deadlift, and Overhead Press - with full customization for your training style:
• Create custom lifts beyond the core four
• Configure cycle length from 3 to 10 weeks including deload weeks
• Adjust weight increments and training max percentages
• Warmup sets automatically calculated for each lift

POWERFUL PRO FEATURES
Upgrade to unlock advanced training tools:
• 11+ pre-built assistance programs (BBB, FSL, Triumvirate, and more)
• Custom assistance program builder for personalized accessory work
• Barbell plate calculator - see exactly what plates to load for every set
• Progress charts and strength graphs to visualize your gains over time
• Secure cloud backup to sync your workouts and training data across devices
• Completely ad-free experience

DESIGNED FOR STRENGTH ATHLETES
Whether you're a powerlifter, CrossFit athlete, or strength training enthusiast, Wendler Log acts as your 5/3/1 workout planner and lifting app so you can stay consistent and build lasting strength.

Perfect for:
• Powerlifting, bodybuilding, and strength training
• CrossFit programming
• Building a bigger squat, bench, deadlift, and press
• Linear and periodized progression
• Gym workouts with barbell and weightlifting training

Switch between kg and lbs. Track your weightlifting progress. Hit new PRs.

INDEPENDENT APP DISCLAIMER
This app is independently developed and not affiliated with Jim Wendler or his official training materials. For the complete 5/3/1 methodology, please support Jim Wendler by purchasing his books.

SUPPORT & FEEDBACK
Need help or have suggestions? Contact us

quotes.text:
Stronglifts is a great program and the lifts in it are the basis for gaining strength and size. The 5x5 on deadlifts and squats soon start to get tough when the weight increases. I'd recommend Wendler 531 instead, I made much better progress with that.

https://jimwendler.com/blogs/jimwendler-com/101065094-5-3-1-for-a-beginner

There are some apps that calculate weights for you and show you what you need to do each session, I use https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vandersw.wenderlogbook&hl=en_GB
